validated_results.title: Light to Moderate Alcohol Consumption and Cancer Incidence: The Norwegian Women and Health Cohort Study.
validated_results.reason: This prospective cohort study evaluated the association between alcohol consumption and kidney cancer incidence in women.

effect_size.excerpt: For kidney cancer, the estimated HR from each additional 12g/day of alcohol consumption was 0.42 (95% CI = 0.24 to 0.75, Figure 2 ). This pattern of association was also observed across subgroup analyses, but with some differences in precision and magnitude.

design.excerpt: Participants were 70,932 women aged 41–70 years, randomly recruited in the Norwegian Women and Health (NOWAC) cohort study from 1996 to 2004.
